summary.en: The merge link: the camera pushes through panel 3 into its shot, three glossy spheres on the field drift together, merge through a viscous neck, squash on landing and settle; the stage name under the sphere. Without the curves after it, the sphere squashes into the rod.
summary.zh: 合并环节：镜头穿过第三格推进它的镜头，场色上三个光滑球体靠拢、经粘稠的颈部融合、落地压扁再回弹、静止；阶段名在球下。后面没有曲线环节时，球压成一根线。

fits: A reel's shading or physics step; the middle of the short chain.
notFor: Films without a WebGL host; anything that must look photoreal.

intent.en: Show volume, light and physics computed per frame, in the line colour.
intent.zh: 用线色展示逐帧算出的体积、光和物理。

content.en: No copy of its own: the stage name and note.
content.zh: 本身没有文案：阶段名和注释。

fits.zh: 作品集里的着色或物理一步；短链的中段。

notFor.zh: 没有 WebGL 的宿主；必须照片级真实的画面。

en: Without WebGL the spheres fall back to flat discs (a P0 failure of the mode): render in a host with WebGL.
Pass the film's chain as `before` / `after`: the hand-offs read the neighbours, and the link's length is fitted with them (a link alone fits differently).
zh: 没有 WebGL 时球体退化成平面圆（模式的 P0 失败）：要在支持 WebGL 的宿主里渲染。
把整片的链作为 before / after 传进来：交接读的是相邻环节，长度也和它们一起拟合（单独一环拟合出的长度不同）。

source.path: assets/templates/thread/film.js merge; shots.js mergeState, squashState, MERGE_CUES; gl.js blob

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
